name: Void Convergence Chamber
description: The Void Convergence Chamber is the deepest arcane nexus in Ka Vethan, where void currents, resonance flows, and Luclinite stabilizers converge. The chamber regulates the city’s void‑arcane balance, preventing catastrophic resonance collapse. Only the highest Akhevan custodians may enter, and even they do so under strict Praesertum oversight.
